name: artisans-corner
description: Artisan's Corner - a multi-vendor marketplace for handmade goods

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:memory" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run audit:ci && npm run test:e2e
